svg.title: AlphaHMS architecture
svg.desc: Scalp EEG and montage spectrograms are windowed, converted to temporal graph sequences, encoded with GATv2, pooled into regions, modelled with BiLSTMs, fused with bidirectional cross-attention and classified into six classes with a KL-divergence objective.
svg.text: electrode colour; used for regional pooling
